judge.rationale: The candidate makes the exact same production code fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and adds a thorough unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. However, it misses the explicit acceptance criterion to update `CHANGELOG.md` and leaves behind an internal `.lore/dod.md` file and a redundant second acceptance test file. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate replaces the line in place under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (which says 'This issue changes none of them') rather than moving the new guarantee into the active specification section, and fails to update shifted test line numbers across the other spec files.
